title: Residual Viremia
summary: Residual Viremia is an Arcane Enhancement for Kitguns that grants them the ability to create a pool of  Toxin on kill.
extract:
Residual Viremia is an Arcane Enhancement for Kitguns that grants them the ability to create a pool of  Toxin on kill.
Can be sold for  ‍1,000.

Effect

Acquisition
Residual Viremia can be acquired from Rotation B of Isolation Vault Bounties (normal and Arcana).

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
Residual Arcanes can only have two active puddles at a time. For example; creating two puddles with a primary kitgun will prevent both your primary and secondary kitgun from creating any until the first two expire.

Trivia
Viremia refers to the entry of viruses into the bloodstream.
The Orokin Writing on the Residual Viremia's image roughly translates to "Viremia".

Bugs
Is supposed to have a 20% status chance, but it appears to be bugged and has no status chance at all.
